title: Learning When to Collaborate: Selective Multi-Agent Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty-Aware Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.33544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal medical reasoning, but existing methods rely on two assumptions that hinder practical deployment: (i) always-active dense collaboration among multiple agents, and (ii) dependence on large cloud-based models that raise privacy and efficiency concerns. In this paper, we challenge both assumptions and propose SMART-Med, a fully local multi-agent method that treats collaboration as a learnable decision rather than a default behavior. Our key insight is that not every medical query requires costly multi-agent deliberation: many can be reliably solved by a single well-trained agent, while only uncertain cases benefit from expert collaboration. translated_title: 学习何时协作：基于不确定性感知路由的选择性多智能体医学推理
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统已成为多模态医学推理的一种有前景的范式，但现有方法依赖于两个阻碍实际部署的假设：（i）多个智能体之间始终活跃的密集协作，以及（ii）对引发隐私和效率问题的大型云端模型的依赖。在本文中，我们对这两个假设均提出挑战，提出了SMART-Med——一种完全本地化的多智能体方法，它将协作视为一种可学习的决策，而非默认行为。我们的关键洞察是：并非每个医疗查询都需要代价高昂的多智能体协商，许多查询可以由单个训练良好的智能体可靠地解决，只有不确定的病例才能从专家协作中受益。基于这一洞察，SMART-Med引入了一种不确定性驱动的路由机制，自适应地决定何时直接回答、何时招募一小部分专家智能体，从而有效地将密集的多智能体推理……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SMART-Med，一种完全本地化的多智能体医学推理框架，通过不确定性感知的路由机制将智能体协作建模为可学习的决策，仅在病例不确定时才招募专家智能体协作，从而在保护隐私、提升效率的同时保证推理准确性。
en_tdlr: SMART-Med is a fully local multi-agent medical reasoning framework that treats collaboration as a learnable decision through an uncertainty-aware routing mechanism, recruiting expert agents only for uncertain cases to jointly improve privacy, efficiency, and reasoning accuracy.
